acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in standard data dependent acquisition mode controlled by Xcalibur 2.1.
alkylation_reagent: cysteine alkylation was performed in situ with iodoacetamide and proteins were digested with Trypsin Gold (Promega) for 4 h at 37 degreesC
cleavage_agent: proteins were digested with Trypsin Gold (Promega) for 4 h at 37 degreesC at an enzyme substrate ratio of 1:20
enrichment_method: IMAC purifications were performed as described, with the following modifications. Peptides were re-suspended in IMAC loading buffer (50% acetonitrile, 0.1% TFA) and incubated with pre-equilibrated Phos-Select beads (Sigma) for 1 h at room temperature.
fragmentation_method: the combination of Mascot Percolator and turbo-SLoMo represents a robust workflow for phosphoproteomic data analysis using CID and ETD fragmentation
instrument: Phosphopeptide samples were analysed online using an Ultimate 3000 nano/Capillary LC System (Dionex) coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source.
ionization_type: coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Velos hybrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source
labeling: inferred: no labeling strategy mentioned; extensive phosphopeptide fractionation was not employed
reduction_reagent: Parasite pellets were re-suspended in extraction buffer (4% SDS, 0.1 M DTT, 0.1 M Tris pH 8, 0.5 mM PMSF, 2 mug/ml Aprotinin/Leupeptin, 20 muM ZnCl and 25 mM Sodium fluoride)
